name: Rachel Solbrig
source: A very timid and soft-spoken girl who goes unnoticed by other students. With the help of Brandon, we’ll learn that she’s really kind and has a real talent for cooking along with a passion for animals as she finds them to be easier to relate to compared to other humans. She has her own club that’s meant to focus on both the love of animals and cooking.
